summary: Frontend-only testing of Zayado public site + cockpit preview. Landing '/' (PublicHome) renders correctly with all required testids and a visible hero image (Pexels, 960px, loaded, not broken). /vision-board loads all 3 templates with live iframes; backend /api/vision/board/preview-public returns 200 HTML for magazine/trajectoire/arbre (5075/7363/6148 bytes). Confirmed the dead-end CTA bug: every CTA on /vision-board navigates to '/?login=1' but the new PublicHome does not read/handle the ?login query param, so users land silently on the landing page with no login modal or action. Also confirmed strong brand/charter divergence between the new PublicHome (charter-compliant: white bg, blue gradient #215480->#001d50, Fraunces/Poppins/Corinthia, red #a10e10 pain accent) and (a) VisionBoardPublic which still uses old navy #1a3a6e + gold #b89855 + beige #f6f3ee, and (b) the Cockpit (Thomas) which is dark-navy + gold-accented and still branded 'MyExtension' instead of 'Zayado'. Preview toolbar works and toggles cockpit/public.

ui_bugs.issue: vb-cta-create, vb-template-cta-magazine/trajectoire/arbre, vb-cta-final all link to '/?login=1' but PublicHome has NO effect handler for ?login query param. User is dropped on landing page with no login modal, no scroll, no action. Every conversion CTA on /vision-board is a dead end.
Modal title reads 'Voici ce que fait MyExtension' — brand should be 'Zayado' per charter. Stale copy across cockpit (menus labeled 'ÉCOSYSTÈME MYEXTENSION AI').
Tile labels overflow / overlap: 'agents (WhatsApp/Telegram)' text overlaps neighbouring 'Mindset & capacité' tile at desktop 1440px. Row layout breaks visually.

integration_issues.issue: CTAs pointing to /?login=1 have no matching handler in PublicHome. Either PublicHome must read ?login and open a login/signup modal, or CTAs must point to a real login/auth route (currently no auth route exists in PublicApp routes — only '/' and '/vision-board').

issues: Off-charter navy #1a3a6e used for headline & CTA bg instead of blue gradient #215480->#001d50
Off-charter gold #b89855 / #d4b982 used for eyebrows, benefit checks and final CTA button — charter has NO gold; accent color should be blood-red #a10e10
Background beige #f6f3ee differs from charter beige #f8f3eb

Typography uses 'font-display' + 'font-serif-italic' classes; charter mandates Fraunces (headings) + Poppins (body) + Corinthia (eyebrow) as used on PublicHome — visual style feels disconnected from the new landing

Imports PublicHeader / UnifiedFooter from LandingHub which likely still carries WordPress-era menu items (Boutique, Avantages, Services, MyExtension AI, 'Parler à Zayado') — this contradicts the 'clean slate' brief (only '/' and '/vision-board' remain)
Whole cockpit is dark-navy with gold accents — inconsistent with charter (white bg, blue gradient, red accent, no gold)
Brand naming inconsistency: 'MyExtension' appears in onboarding modal and apps menu heading instead of 'Zayado'
Cockpit header shows 'Boutique / Avantages / Services / MyExtension AI / Parler à Zayado' items that no longer exist on the reduced public site

action_items: Fix the dead-end conversion path: either (a) implement a ?login=1 handler in PublicHome that opens a login/signup modal or scrolls to a CTA, or (b) repoint all /vision-board CTAs to a real signup route (and add that route to PublicApp).

Rebrand /vision-board to the new charter: replace #1a3a6e with the blue gradient #215480->#001d50, remove all gold (#b89855 / #d4b982), swap accent to blood-red #a10e10, align beige to #f8f3eb, and use Fraunces/Poppins/Corinthia like PublicHome. Ideally reuse the visual language (hero + pain + modules blocks) from PublicHome for cohesion.

Do NOT reuse PublicHeader/UnifiedFooter from LandingHub on /vision-board — they still expose removed WP sections (Boutique, Avantages, Services, MyExtension AI). Build a minimal charter-compliant header/footer matching PublicHome instead.

Cockpit rebrand: replace all remaining 'MyExtension' strings with 'Zayado' (onboarding modal title, apps menu 'ÉCOSYSTÈME MYEXTENSION AI', etc.). Consider aligning cockpit palette with the new white/blue-gradient/red charter, or explicitly document that the cockpit keeps a dark theme.
Fix the header apps popover overflow where 'agents (WhatsApp/Telegram)' overlaps the adjacent tile.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicApp routes are '/' and '/vision-board' only, yet VisionBoardPublic still deep-links to '/?login=1' — the routing/CTA layer is out of sync with the reduced route set (Navigate * -> /). This will bleed conversion.
VisionBoardPublic hard-codes brand colors #1a3a6e and #b89855; there is no theme token layer — every charter change will require touching this file directly.
Iframes on /vision-board are decorative (pointer-events-none) which is good, but they trigger 3 server-side HTML renders on every page view — consider a poster image fallback for perf/SEO.
main.jsx: previewMode() is read only at module load; toggling via localStorage requires full reload (already the case in PreviewToolbar), which is fine but should be documented.
LandingHub is imported by VisionBoardPublic but the brief says WP/legal/simulators were removed — verify LandingHub does not silently re-introduce dead links or 404 targets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Set localStorage.zay_preview_mode='public' then reload to see the public site; 'app' to see cockpit. PublicHome hero image loads from Pexels (external) — flag if Pexels ever blocks. Backend /api/vision/board/preview-public?template=<magazine|trajectoire|arbre> returns 200 HTML directly (5-7kB), used by iframes. Dead-end CTA bug is the top blocker.
rca of the issue: PublicHome (new landing) was rewritten from scratch and only handles static Links to /vision-board. VisionBoardPublic was NOT updated during the reduction: it still targets '/?login=1' assuming the old landing consumed that query to open a login flow. In the new PublicApp there is no ?login handler and no login route, so the CTA becomes a silent no-op. Reproduction: localStorage.setItem('zay_preview_mode','public'); goto /vision-board; click any CTA -> URL becomes /?login=1 and PublicHome renders unchanged. Mitigation: implement a useEffect in PublicHome reading searchParams.get('login')==='1' to open a login/signup modal, OR change all vb-* CTAs to point to a real signup route (and register it).
